steps.name: Install the existing bounded compiler namespace and pinned bindings
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/guest-tools"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/guest-tools" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Read only this run's identity-checked existing native products
Check captured-source and exact-outcome refusal controls
Execute native references and actual signed catchable errors, trap and fresh invocation
Retain bounded diagnostic evidence including failures

with.name: rust-compatibility-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-compatibility/qualification.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-compatibility/FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-compatibility/capture.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-compatibility/compatibility-execution-report.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-compatibility/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-compatibility/build/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-compatibility/build/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-compatibility/build/component.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-compatibility/build/component.wit
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-compatibility/node/workflow.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-compatibility/node/FAILED.json

reviewReason: Add signed Rust native-reference/captured unsupported-operation qualification using this run existing native products; retain every existing command, bound and prior case.
